mapper.select: SELECT * FROM advertisement WHERE status = 1 AND start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO advertisement (title, image_url, link_url, product_id, merchant_id, position, start_time, end_time, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{imageUrl}, #{linkUrl}, #{productId}, #{merchantId}, #{position}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE advertisement SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
